name: Socialism
overview: Scripture acknowledges the responsibility of individuals to provide for their own needs while also commanding care for those who have fallen into poverty, as seen in commands to gather provisions according to one's household (Exodus 16:16) and to relieve a brother in need (Leviticus 25:35). The law forbids stealing (Exodus 20:15), upholding the principle of respecting personal property. While communal support is encouraged through practices like tithing (Deuteronomy 14:28), ultimate trust is placed in the Lord rather than in human leaders or systems (Psalms 118:8; 146:3), emphasizing reliance on God’s provision over any human economic structure.
